narrative: 有人正被注视、被困住，或被“取景”。内层的画框决定了谁能被允许进入这幅“画中之画”。
一个站在门口的男人，究竟是正在归家，还是被拒之门外，取决于我们站在门框的哪一侧。如果第二个矩形只是一位居中人物身后的一处好看拱门，这就不是对的工具。
如果没有人能从那个开口进出，你添加的只是一张贴纸。脏乱的边缘是啃咬式的，
而框中框切割出的是一条干净的内部边界。你可以同时拥有两者：透过一扇干净的门看到一个脏乱的外部视野。
要决定的是哪一条边界真正拥有这个主体。
how: 构建两个矩形。摆放摄影机的位置，使内层开口的边、顶部（以及通常还有）门槛都清晰可读。
控制两个空间之间的曝光对比：室内暖、室外冷，或反过来。中等广角（32mm到40mm）能同时展现两层边界。
如果内层画框吞没了外层，你做的其实只是重新裁切。提示词：Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention.
when: 用它表现登场、告别、走廊中的暧昧关系，以及任何被一栋房子“取景”的人物。不要在一幅肖像背后随意放一个拱门，就称之为嵌套式的注意力。
vs: 脏画面（Dirty Frame）用虚焦的杂物占据外层边缘。框中框则是一条图形化的内层边界，通常是清晰的。
窗景构图（Windows）堆叠出许多个开口，直到整栋建筑变成一张镜头组成的网格。屏中屏（Screen in Screen）则是一幅本身就是显示屏的画面。
负空间（Negative Space）可以用空白环绕一个较小的内层画框。窥视视角（Voyeur）则是从隐蔽处透过这个开口观看的一种伦理姿态。
examples_film: 《搜索者》（The Searchers）在门框构图中开场和收场：沙漠与家园是被门框分割开的两个国度；《花样年华》（In the Mood for Love）用门框和走廊缝隙来容纳那些不能公开的相遇。
进入或离开这个内层矩形，本身就是一次无需剪辑就能完成的转折。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是一处装饰性的拱门。破绽是一道谁也无法穿过的装饰曲线，而主体早已填满了整个屏幕。
修正方法：至少展现内层边界的三条边，并赋予门槛一个真正的功能。

faq.q: 电影中的框中框（Frame within Frame）是什么？
faq.a: 屏幕内部的一条建筑或图形边界把主体围合起来：门、窗、拱门、镜子、缝隙。画面中存在两个矩形。内层那个决定着归属、排斥，或“被取景”的状态。

faq.q: 框中框（Frame within Frame）与脏画面（Dirty Frame）有何区别？
faq.a: 脏画面用肩膀、玻璃、树叶或人群啃咬外层边缘，通常是虚焦的。框中框则是围绕动作的第二个清晰矩形。一个是边缘的占据，另一个是嵌套式的边界。两者可以结合使用。

faq.q: 什么时候该用框中框（Frame within Frame）？
faq.a: 当有人正被注视、被困住、被欢迎，或被一栋建筑“取景”时使用它。跨越门槛这一动作应当具有意义。不要把它当成一次给肖像加的好看内层裁切。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写框中框（Frame within Frame）的提示词？
faq.a: 要求出现第二个矩形并明确指出它是什么。示例：Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention。说明我们身处门槛的哪一侧以及曝光的分配方式。

narrative: Someone is watched, trapped, or pictured. The inner frame decides who is allowed in the picture of the picture.
A man in a doorway is either coming home or locked out, depending on which side of the jamb we stand. It is the wrong tool when the second rectangle is only a pretty arch behind a centered face.
If nobody could enter or leave that aperture, you added a sticker. Dirty edges chew.
A frame-in-frame cuts a clean inner border. You can have both: a dirty outer view through a clean door.
Decide which border owns the subject.
how: Compose two rectangles. Place the camera so the inner opening has readable sides, top, and (often) threshold.
Control exposure between the two spaces: interior warm, exterior cold, or the reverse. A moderate wide (32mm to 40mm) shows both borders.
If the inner frame swallows the outer, you have simply recropped. Prompt: Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention.
when: Use it for arrivals, farewells, affairs in corridors, and anyone pictured by a house. Do not drop a random arch behind a portrait and call it nested attention.
vs: Dirty Frame occupies the outer edges with out-of-focus matter. Frame-in-frame is a graphic inner border, often sharp.
Windows stacks many apertures until the building is a grid of shots. Screen in Screen is a picture that is itself a display.
Negative Space can surround a small inner frame with emptiness. Voyeur is the ethical position of watching through that aperture from concealment.
examples_film: The Searchers opens and closes on doorway compositions: desert and home as two countries split by a jamb. In the Mood for Love uses doorframes and corridor gaps to contain encounters that cannot be public.
Entering or leaving the inner rectangle is the cut you do not have to make.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a decorative arch. The tell is an ornamental curve that nobody could walk through, with the subject already filling the screen.
The fix is to show the inner border on at least three sides and to give the threshold a job.

faq.q: What is frame within frame in film?
faq.a: An architectural or graphic border inside the screen encloses the subject: door, window, arch, mirror, gap. There are two rectangles. The inner one decides belonging, exclusion, or being pictured.

faq.q: Frame within Frame vs Dirty Frame
faq.a: A dirty frame chews the outer edges with shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd, often soft. A frame within a frame is a second hard rectangle around the action. One is occupancy of the edge. The other is a nested border. They can combine.

faq.q: When should I use frame within frame?
faq.a: Use it when someone is watched, trapped, welcomed, or pictured by a building. A crossing of the threshold should be able to matter. Do not use it as a pretty inner crop on a portrait.

faq.q: How do I prompt frame within frame for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for a second rectangle and name it. Example: Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention. State which side of the threshold we occupy and the exposure split.
